nodes.name: Chunk Document
nodes.notes: DETERMINÍSTICO: trocea por párrafos (≈600 caracteres) sin partir frases. Cada fragmento lleva un hash de su contenido: lo que no cambió no se vuelve a guardar.

nodes.name: Mock Embeddings
nodes.notes: Sustituto local: vector por hashing de palabras (256 dimensiones). Mide coincidencia de palabras, no significado.

nodes.name: Embeddings API
nodes.notes:
CONECTA AQUÍ: proveedor de embeddings (credencial "Embeddings API"). Debe devolver 256 dimensiones por texto. Contrato SIN verificar; la respuesta se valida estrictamente.
Sin retryOnFail propio: los reintentos con backoff exponencial los hace el bucle "Embeddings API · check".

parameters.query:
WITH d AS (
  INSERT INTO kb_docs (doc_id, title) VALUES ($1, $2)
  ON CONFLICT (doc_id) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, updated_at = now() RETURNING doc_id
), del AS (
  DELETE FROM kb_chunks WHERE doc_id = $1 AND content_hash NOT IN (SELECT content_hash FROM jsonb_to_recordset($3::jsonb) AS x(content_hash text)) RETURNING id
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO kb_chunks (doc_id, chunk_idx, content, content_hash, embedding)
  SELECT $1, x.idx, x.content, x.content_hash, x.embedding::vector
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($3::jsonb) AS x(idx int, content text, content_hash text, embedding text), d
  ON CONFLICT (doc_id, content_hash) DO UPDATE SET chunk_idx = EXCLUDED.chunk_idx
  RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS inserted
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ins WHERE inserted) AS inserted, (SELECT count(*) FROM ins WHERE NOT inserted) AS unchanged, (SELECT count(*) FROM del) AS removed

nodes.name: Upsert Chunks
nodes.notes: Idempotente: mismo contenido = misma fila. Los fragmentos que ya no existen en el documento se borran.

nodes.name: Upserted
nodes.notes: Verifica que se guardó exactamente lo esperado; si no, falla ruidosamente.

nodes.name: Assert Ingest
nodes.notes: Falla ruidosamente si los embeddings fallaron: el documento NO queda a medias en la KB.

parameters.content:
## Support · KB Ingest
One document → deterministic chunks (hash per chunk) → embeddings (local hashing in mock mode, any provider in live mode) → idempotent upsert into pgvector. Re-ingesting an unchanged document changes nothing; removed paragraphs are deleted.

### Per-step log → Postgres
Nodes "Log · …": side branches.
